title: SAFE-Merge: Data-Free Continual Model Merging with General Knowledge Preservation
summary: Adds explicit protection for pretrained knowledge to task-merging methods through a sparse risk-aware mask and low-rank recovery. It requires offline merging computation but adds no inference cost to the resulting model. It matters primarily for people merging specialized models, often in vision or CLIP, and needs validation on their own models because the gains are relative to merging baselines.
rationale: A lightweight technique without extra inference cost, but relevant mainly to the niche workflow of continual model merging.
technique: Data-free continual merging with risk masks

claims.statement: Adds explicit protection for pretrained knowledge to task-merging methods through a sparse risk-aware mask and low-rank recovery. It requires offline merging computation but adds no inference cost to the resulting model. It matters primarily for people merging specialized models, often in vision or CLIP, and needs validation on their own models because the gains are relative to merging baselines.

Reports consistently better H-scores on vision and language benchmarks; long CLIP task sequences improve substantially over NUFILT with the highest accuracy, without a numerical factor in the abstract.
